verdict.rationale: Superhuman's own MCP page documents one-prompt bulk handling of follow-ups: it checks read status, drafts all the nudges, and schedules sends. A community user separately reports trashing or marking done all messages from the same sender at once. Auto Archive also clears whole categories automatically, but that is a background rule rather than a user-invoked bulk action. missing for 10: first-party docs for general multi-select bulk actions (archive, label or move many threads), documented limits on scope or scale, and hands-on corroboration of the MCP bulk follow-up flow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.
When deleting, you can trash or mark done all messages from the same sender.
